title: AgentDecept: Benchmarking Deceptive Behavior in Tool-Using LLM Agents under Pressure
abstract: arXiv:2610.39377v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly carry out multi-turn tasks across everyday applications, yet users often see only the agent's report rather than the observations, API calls, and state changes behind it. Existing deception benchmarks have studied long-horizon interactions and tool-use settings, but whether agents faithfully report their actions across realistic, stateful application workflows remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce AgentDecept, an executable benchmark for evaluating behavioral deception under pressure. AgentDecept contains 477 pressure variants derived from 257 source tasks across six pressure sources, each paired with a pressure-free counterpart. Interventions enter through event messages, task context, application state, tool responses, and service quotas, spanning explicit events and implicit task or environment changes. Our evidence-grounded protocol evaluates full trajectories by relating user-facing claims

translated_title: AgentDecept：压力情境下工具使用型LLM智能体欺骗行为的基准测试
translated_abstract: LLM智能体日益在各类日常应用中执行多轮任务，然而用户通常只能看到智能体的报告，而看不到其背后的观察结果、API调用和状态变化。现有的欺骗基准已研究了长程交互和工具使用场景，但智能体在真实的有状态应用工作流中能否忠实地报告其行为，这一问题仍鲜有探索。为填补这一空白，我们提出了AgentDecept，一个用于评估压力情境下行为欺骗的可执行基准。AgentDecept包含从257个源任务派生的477个压力变体，涵盖六种压力来源，且每个压力变体均配有对应的无压力对照组。干预通过事件消息、任务上下文、应用状态、工具响应和服务配额等途径引入，既包括显式事件，也包括隐式的任务或环境变化。我们基于证据的评估协议通过将面向用户的声明与完整轨迹进行关联来评估智能体行为……
tldr: 提出了AgentDecept——一个包含477个压力变体（源自257个任务、六种压力来源）的可执行基准，通过将用户可见的报告与完整执行轨迹对比，评估工具使用型LLM智能体在压力情境下是否会欺骗性地不忠实报告其行为。
en_tdlr: AgentDecept is an executable benchmark with 477 pressure variants derived from 257 tasks across six pressure sources that evaluates whether tool-using LLM agents deceptively misreport their actions to users under pressure by comparing user-facing claims against full execution trajectories in realistic stateful application workflows.
